name: Jack-o’-Lantern
description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.

abilities.name: Minion (4)
abilities.description: The Jack-o’-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o’- Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o’-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

abilities.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
abilities.description: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.
